summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Optowire Angular 21 SSR catalog. Found and fixed 4 critical API parameter mismatches that were preventing category filtering, search, and sorting from working. All 10 requested features now verified working after fixes.

issues: Active category (e.g. Telecommunication) button not highlighted with cyan background class when selected - the active check uses 'selectedCategoryId() === cat.id' but the comparison may fail if types differ (number vs string)

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: CategoryService.getBySlug() was calling /web/category/:slug which returns 404 from external API. Now searches the flattened getAll() category tree instead.
FIXED: catalog.ts loadProducts() used 'search' param but API requires 'productName' - was returning all 938 results regardless of search query.
FIXED: catalog.ts loadProducts() used 'categories: [id]' (array) but API requires 'categoryId: number' (single integer) - category filtering was broken, showing all 938 instead of filtered count.
FIXED: Sort values used dashes ('price-asc') but API requires underscores ('price_asc') - sorting was returning null total from API.
NOTE: The SSR app requires yarn build + supervisor restart for code changes to take effect - no hot reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Angular 21 SSR app with live external API at https://planetworkspace.com/api (x-partner-key: 94fa5fc3-9534-4bb5-8722-f724f84a5594). API parameter mappings: productName (not search), categoryId: number (not categories: []), price_asc underscore format (not price-asc dash). Category slugs: telecommunication (id=1, 582 products), network-equipments (id=91, 353 products). Total catalog: 938 products. App must be rebuilt (yarn build) and frontend restarted for code changes to take effect.

bug1_category_slug_404.root_cause: CategoryService.getBySlug() called GET /web/category/:slug which the external API does not support (returns 404). When 404 occurs, the error handler set selectedCategoryId=null and loaded all products, bypassing category filter.
bug1_category_slug_404.fix: Rewrote getBySlug() to call getAll() and flatten the category tree to find by slug.

bug2_search_param_mismatch.root_cause: catalog.ts loadProducts() sent 'search' in POST body but API expects 'productName'. The API silently ignored 'search' and returned all 938 products.

bug3_category_id_array.root_cause: catalog.ts sent 'categories: [1]' (array) in POST body but API expects 'categoryId: 1' (single integer). API ignored the array and returned all products.
bug3_category_id_array.fix: Changed criteria to use 'categoryId: selectedCategoryId()' (number directly).

bug4_sort_value_format.root_cause: Sort option values used dash format ('price-asc') but API expects underscore format ('price_asc'). API returned null total for dash format.
bug4_sort_value_format.fix: Changed sortOptions values to use underscore: 'price_asc', 'price_desc'.
